Workshop

Linux Installation Workshop

A hands-on session for The Source Lab’s core members on how a computer boots and how to install a GNU/Linux desktop. Members followed the installation material together with their laptops.

Session details

Audience
The Source Lab core members
Format
Hands-on workshop

What the session covered

Workshop material

The workshop followed a machine from power-on to a running system. It connected each installation choice to what happens during boot.

Boot and firmware

Follow the boot chain, compare BIOS and UEFI, and see where GRUB, MBR and GPT fit.

Preparing an installation

Compare distributions, create a bootable USB, and try a live session before choosing an installation setup.

Dual boot and troubleshooting

The session covered Windows dual boot, options for Intel and Apple Silicon Macs, and diagnosing graphics, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth issues.
